subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: What proof should be required before maintainers close this canonical tool-result text-loss issue?
rationale: Current main has partial helper and prompt-history fixes, but the remaining failure depends on long-session model-visible payload behavior that UI-only tests and helper-level tests do not fully prove.

options.title: Require installed long-session proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a merged fix is validated in a redacted installed WebChat, Discord, Telegram, or equivalent run that crosses the reported context-pressure threshold and preserves tool output text.

options.title: Accept helper-level proof after merge
options.body: Close after the focused prompt-projection PR lands with green helper coverage, accepting that installed-channel proof can follow in QA.

options.title: Split aggregate and media cases
options.body: Close only the aggregate-truncation portion after proof and track payload-less media or provider placeholder hardening in separate PRs or issues.

recommendation.title: Require installed long-session proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a merged fix is validated in a redacted installed WebChat, Discord, Telegram, or equivalent run that crosses the reported context-pressure threshold and preserves tool output text.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main session projection fix and are the strongest routing candidate for deciding the proof standard around session prompt history.
